target: mericarp (PO_0020075), region: the inner face where the two mericarps join; vittae counted on it are vitta (FLOPO_0986042) located on that face
reason: In Apiaceae the commissure is the inner face of the mericarp. '2 on commissure' counts vittae there and 'width' or 'pale' describe that face. It is a region of an existing class, not a separate organ.
A comparison of size with no second term ('2 larger ones'), like 'smaller' and 'broader', which were rejected on 2026-11-13.

Narrower: a vein running lengthwise. 'Vein' is a PO synonym of vascular bundle. The count follows pattern 03 (count of parts). 'Longitudinal' can be added as the quality longitudinal orientation (PATO:0005024), as in rule C337.
Exact: 'petiolar gland' is already a synonym of PO_0009057 in config/po_lexicon.tsv. It probably failed to match because of the plural or the parser.

A counting suffix, not a part. Note: flora_counted_parts.tsv maps 'celled' to locule, but these examples count the cells of hairs and paraphyses ('1--4-celled distal portion', 'paraphyses 3-8-celled'). There the counted part is plant cell (PO_0009002), not locule.

Comes from 'jugate' or 'juguées': a count of leaflet pairs. It is already covered by the 'jugate' suffix (leaflet, collection size 2) in flora_counted_parts.tsv. The French '-juguée(s)' form should be added to that suffix. 'jugate' was rejected as not a structure on 2026-11-13.
A branching quality with a count ('2--3-forked'), not a part.
Exact: the plural of leaf. It did not match because the word was not reduced to its singular form.
Describes the counted veins or lines ('3 parallel veins'). It is an arrangement quality, not a part.

Narrower: a sterile, stamen-like member of the androecium that floras set apart from true staminodes. Its qualities (fimbriate, crenate, obtuse, bifid) are those of a staminode. A separate class would add nothing a pattern can use.
A colour word describing the counted part ('3 pale veins', 'pale lenticels').
Narrower: a compound fruit from fused carpels, as in Annonaceae. 'syncarp' is already a synonym of PO_0009001 in po_lexicon.tsv.

The plural of 'margin', which was rejected on 2026-11-13 as a general part that needs its organ. It should be handled as the region 'margin' of the organ being described (for example leaf lamina margin, PO_0025009), not as a bearer of its own.
A shape word describing counted teeth, lobes or ridges.
The plural of 'scar', rejected on 2026-11-13 as a general part. 'leaf-scars' should go to leaf scar (FLOPO_0986052). Pedicel scars and hair scars need their organ.
A position quality of the counted flowers or umbels, not a part.
An arrangement quality ('leaves 6-8 whorled', 'in 2 whorls of 3'). 'whorl' and 'verticil' were rejected as general parts on 2026-11-13.
A shape word describing appendages, warts or outgrowths.
Narrower: the main veins, either primary veins from the base or secondary veins on each side. Order and organ vary between floras, so the general vein class is the safe target.
A surface quality ('tuberculate appendages'). The 'tubercles' in these examples are general outgrowths. They are not PO tubercle (PO_0025352), which is the cactus podarium.
A margin quality of counted lobes (entire, FLOPO_0985009).

target: plant cell (PO_0009002) and part_of some non-vascular leaf (PO_0025075); pattern 12 (part of a qualified whole)
reason: A cell of the leaf blade of a moss or liverwort, in Flora of North America bryophyte descriptions. PO has alar cell (PO_0030057) but no general lamina cell. A cell that is part of a non-vascular leaf expresses it without a new term. A PO proposal is optional given the volume (1882 statements).
Exact: a segment of the floral corona is one of its divisions, as with perigone lobe and petal lobe on 2026-11-13. Examples are Asclepiadoideae (stipitate, conduplicate, exserted).

reason: The laminal cell in the region 'base' of the moss leaf. The same rule as 'laminal cell' plus the base region.
Exact: 'vittae' was wrongly reduced to 'vitae'. These are the oil tubes of the Apiaceae fruit ('3 in each furrow', '2 on commissure').
Narrower: the chaffy scale on the receptacle of a flower head (Asteraceae), which subtends a single floret. That is a flower bract, and 'chaff' is already a PO synonym of PO_0009034.
Exact in Flora of Tropical East Africa usage: the cup or tube of the receptacle that bears the sepals, petals and stamens, i.e. the hypanthium. 'Lobes of receptacle-tube' are its rim lobes.

reason: The laminal cell in the distal part of the moss leaf. The same rule as 'laminal cell' plus the distal region.

label: stelidium
parent: is_a PO_0025001 (cardinal organ part); part_of FLOPO_0986015 (gynostemium)
definition: A cardinal organ part (PO:0025001) that is one of a usually paired tooth- or arm-like projection at the apex or sides of the gynostemium (FLOPO:0986015) of an orchid flower, flanking the anther, as in Bulbophyllum and Pleurothallidinae.
reason: A real orchid structure with no class. Floras use it with shape, size and visibility (5 floras, 151 statements). It cannot be expressed as a region of the gynostemium. Propose it to PO together with gynostemium.

A general part that needs its organ (labellum, corolla, leaf or corona). 'mid-lobe', 'midlobe' and 'lateral lobe' were rejected for the same reason on 2026-11-13. When the organ is known it is that organ's lobe in median position (for example labellum lobe, FLOPO_0986028).
